caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with a wide, rounded brim and a slightly gathered crown at the back. The bonnet is rendered in shades of light brown and beige, with the inner part of the brim being a lighter cream color. There are pleats on the crown, and a bow is tied at the back right side, made from the same brown fabric as the bonnet. Two long brown ribbons extend from the lower edge of the bonnet, ending in points. Below the colored bonnet, there is a smaller sketch in grayscale pencil, showing the same bonnet from a similar angle, with the same pleats, bow, and ribbon details. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or elements present.
title: Quaker Bonnet
